METHOD OF ANALYSES
Analysis
Reference or Procedure
pH, paste
Diagnosis and Improvement of Saline and Alkali Soils, U.S.D.A. Handbook 60, p. 102.
Saturation percentage
Diagnosis and Improvement of Saline and Alkali Soils, U.S.D.A. Handbook 60, p. 84, Methods 2 and 3A.
Conductivity, on a saturation extract
Diagnosis and Improvement of Saline and Alkali Soils, U.S.D.A. Handbook 60, p. 89.
Sodium, from saturation extract
Determined by atomic absorption spectrophotometry.
Calcium, from saturation extract
Same as above.
Magnesium, from saturation extract
Same as above.
Sodium Adsorption Ratio
SAR = \frac{Na}{\sqrt{\frac{Ca + Mg}{2}}}
where: Na, Ca, and Mg are expressed in terms of milliequivalents per liter
(see U.S.D.A. Handbook 60, p. 72)
Nitrate
Phenoldisulfonic acid method, ASA Agronomy Monograph No. 9, p. 1212, Method 84-5.
Ammonium
Jackson, M.A., 1958, Soil Chemical Analysis, p. 191, 194-195.
Boron, hot water extractable
Diagnosis and Improvement of Saline and Alkali Soils, U.S.D.A. Handbook 60, p. 142, Method 73B.
